Fix font squares instead of letters in golden tests. Update goldens.

The ticket is: "Fix font squares instead of letters in golden tests. Update goldens."

This is a Flutter project with golden tests. The issue is that golden tests render squares (tofu boxes) instead of letters, likely because the CI environment doesn't have the fonts (like Ahem font or Arial) available. The standard fix is to load a real font (e.g., Roboto/Arial from `google_fonts` or a bundled font asset) in the golden test binding, using `FontLoader` to load the font bytes into the Flutter test engine.

#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''

name: 'AI Teammate'

  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&

    types: [assigned]

# AI Teammate — thin stub over the factory home (dmtools-agentic-workflows).
#
# ALL logic lives in IstiN/dmtools-agentic-workflows/.github/workflows/
# factory-teammate.yml (guard, legs, verdict, sessions, memory). This file
# carries only what cannot live in a reusable workflow: the repository
# event triggers, the per-issue concurrency group, and the call itself.
#
#   issue assigned/labeled → factory guard → dev/review/rework leg
#   workflow_dispatch (SM / manual) → leg pinned by input
#
# Secrets (EXPLICIT mapping — the factory DECLARES SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN as a
# required named secret, and `secrets: inherit` does not satisfy
# required-secret validation at call time):
#   SOURCE_GITHUB_TOKEN (required); AI provider keys ride the generic
#   CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn slots (name via CUSTOM_PROVIDER_KEYn_NAME).
name: 'AI Teammate'

run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' &&
      format('▶ {0} (SM) · {1}', github.event.inputs.leg,
        (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
        || format('gh-{0}', github.event.inputs.issue)) ||
      github.event.label.name == 'pr_approved' && '✅ pr_approved' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:rework' && '🔧 rework' ||
      github.event.label.name == 'agent:review' && '🔍 review' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:rework') && '🔧 rework' ||
      contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'agent:review') && '🔍 review' ||
      '⚒️ dev' }}
  · ${{ (github.event.inputs.pr || '') != '' && format('pr-{0}', github.event.inputs.pr)
      || format('gh-{0}', github.event.issue.number || github.event.inputs.issue) }}${{
      github.event.issue.title && format(': {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}

on:
  issues:
    # assigned + labeled — the issues trigger is the dev intake (assignment
    # to the machine login); label events let the pr_approved re-entry and
    # manual agent:review/agent:rework overrides reach the guard. The awf
    # guard skips status-label echoes at evaluation.
    types: [assigned]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue:
        description: 'Issue number (empty for PR-anchored runs, #687)'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
      leg:
        description: 'Which leg to run'
        required: true
        type: choice
        options: [dev, review, rework]
      reason:
        description: 'Why this dispatch (audit trail, shown in logs)'
        required: false
        type: string
      pr:
        description: 'PR number for PR-anchored review runs (#687) — the SM dispatches review with pr instead of issue'
        required: false
        type: string
        default: ''
